name: apresai-skills
description: Production-ready skills and plugins for Claude Code by apresai

plugins.name: apple-release
plugins.description: Apple app release automation for TestFlight and App Store Connect. Includes /release, /release-testflight, /release-consistency, /release-xcodecloud, and /app-store-audit (pre-submission risk audit against the full App Store Review Guidelines — project/binary AND App Store Connect metadata). Supports iOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS.

plugins.name: go-lambda
plugins.description: Comprehensive Go Lambda development with provided.al2023 runtime, ARM64/Graviton2 architecture, AWS SDK v2, and CDK infrastructure. Covers scaffolding, migration, best practices, and production patterns.

plugins.name: nextjs-opennext
plugins.description: Deploy Next.js applications to AWS Lambda using OpenNext and CDK. Covers App Router, Server Components, ISR, streaming, middleware, and production deployment patterns.

plugins.name: bubbletea-design
plugins.description: Build beautiful, idiomatic terminal UIs in Go with Bubble Tea v2, Bubbles v2, and Lip Gloss v2. Architecture patterns, component catalog, styling recipes, async/streaming patterns, v1→v2 migration map, and visual design principles for sexy TUIs.

plugins.name: image-encoding
plugins.description: Modern web image encoding with AVIF (primary) and WebP (fallback). Covers cwebp/dwebp/avifenc CLIs, the <picture> cascade pattern, browser-support cliffs, and when each format wins.

plugins.name: chad-review
plugins.description: 6-pass autonomous pre-commit code review. Reviews uncommitted working-tree changes (or the last commit if clean) across drift, behavior-and-risk, tests, observability, dependency-freshness, and simplification. Runs the project's own deterministic gate in the parent before any agent launches, and a repo with no validation entrypoint is itself a finding with a ready-to-paste target. FRESHNESS finds work by census (declared manifests, pinned external references such as runtime enums and model IDs, undeclared prerequisites) rather than by manifest filename, so doc, prompt, and IaC repos get audited instead of marked N/A, and no agent is ever spawned just to discover whether there is work. Every sub-check reports or marks itself N/A. Diff-shape aware (light and deps-only diffs skip the fan-out). Sub-agents receive the rubric's path rather than pasted rubric text, and the prompt contract loads only when a launch is imminent. Session-relative sonnet/opus tiering with an explicit model on every launch. Read-only on the diff, and it backs up untracked files when there are any, because that guarantee is prompt-enforced, not tool-enforced.

plugins.name: tidy
plugins.description: Applies quality-only cleanups to the code you just changed: missed reuse, dead code, wrong altitude, needless abstraction, defensive noise, and compatibility scaffolding. Scope-fenced to the current diff, never changes behavior, never commits, and proves it by re-running the project's own tests. Pins an explicit model on every sub-agent instead of inheriting the session tier. Runs BEFORE /chad-review, so the gate reviews the tidied diff.

plugins.name: codex-br
plugins.description: Run OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock (model openai.gpt-5.5, provider amazon-bedrock) instead of the default ChatGPT backend, via a `br` Codex profile. Adds /codex-br task (delegate a coding/diagnosis/research task), /codex-br review (built-in reviewer), and /codex-br adversarial-review (steerable challenge review). Defaults to maximum reasoning effort (xhigh).

plugins.name: xai-voice
plugins.description: Master reference for xAI's three voice APIs: Grok Text-to-Speech (POST /v1/tts), Speech-to-Text (/v1/stt), and the realtime Speech-to-Speech voice agent (wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime). Live-verified request and response contracts, the full 26-voice catalog (docs still say 5), speech-tag semantics, a production Go client, and the doc-vs-reality discrepancies that ship broken audio.
